facts.fact: Burkina Faso, Mali and Niger signed the AES framework convention on cooperation in digital and postal matters (infrastructure sharing, connectivity, cybersecurity, e-government, AI) in Ouagadougou on 27 November 2026, per a ministry release carried by Wakat Sera.
facts.system: Convention-cadre de cooperation entre les Etats confederes dans les domaines du numerique et des postes
